component.name: RustCut
component.summary: Local video cutter with a render queue, tagging and rating in RustView

description.p: RustCut opens a video in an embedded mpv player, lets you mark the sections to keep on a zoomable timeline, applies filters with a live preview and renders the result with FFmpeg through a persistent queue. The rendered clips are tagged and rated directly in the RustView library.

ul.li: Timeline with sections, marks, zoom and NLE-style keys (I/O, J/K/L, frame steps), all keys configurable
Filters with a live preview: crop on the video with handles or by holding Ctrl, auto-crop, deinterlace, resize, rotate and mirror, two-pass deshake with a probe render
Render profiles for x264, x265 and AV1 with a simple and an expert view, checked by the real encoder
Queue with parallel workers, pause and resume, crash recovery, progress, ETA and a size estimate per job
Every output is verified before it replaces a file; an existing file is never touched by a failed render
Tag and rate the clips in RustView with its own tag tree and rating bar
Taskbar progress, notifications, an optional tray icon and an action when the queue is done
